prompt:
The section sections/newsletter-goal-block.liquid renders a newsletter signup block. Update its markup to add compact number formatting, a discount line and a progress-toward-goal line, all using integer arithmetic. Keep the {% schema %} block byte-for-byte unchanged. Inputs. All inputs are under section.settings. There are no top-level inputs. - section.settings.heading: string or null. - section.settings.subscriber_count: integer or null. - section.settings.discount_percent: integer or null. - section.settings.goal: integer or null. Compact format. Apply this to any integer n that is 0 or greater. Never round up; always truncate. - If n < 1000, print n as is. - If 1000 <= n < 1000000: - Let W = floor(n / 1000) and T = floor((n mod 1000) / 100). - Print "W.Tk" when T > 0, or "Wk" when T is 0. - Examples: 1250 gives 1.2k, 1999 gives 1.9k, 1000 gives 1k, 999999 gives 999.9k. - If n >= 1000000, use the same rule with 1000000, 100000 and the suffix "M". - Examples: 2050000 gives 2M, 1500000 gives 1.5M. Output. Always output exactly one wrapper:
...
. Inside it, output the following elements in this order, with no whitespace between tags. 1. Heading. Strip leading and trailing whitespace from the heading. If the result is non-empty, output

HEADING

, HTML-escaped with the escape filter. Otherwise output nothing. 2. Count. Output this only when subscriber_count is not null and subscriber_count >= 1. The element is

Join C subscribers

, where C is the compact format of subscriber_count. When subscriber_count is exactly 1, the text is "Join 1 subscriber" (singular). 3. Discount. Output this only when discount_percent is not null and 1 <= discount_percent <= 100. The element is

Get D% off your first order

, where D is the raw integer. 4. Progress. Output this only when all of the following hold: - goal is not null and goal > 0. - subscriber_count is not null and subscriber_count >= 0. The percentage P is subscriber_count * 100 / goal, rounded to the nearest whole number with exact halves rounding up, then capped at 100. It must be computed with integer arithmetic only. - Examples: 1/8 gives 13, 3/200 gives 2, 1250/3000 gives 42, 995/1000 gives 100, 1999/1000 gives 100. The element is

P% of our G goal

, where G is the compact format of goal. Example: if all inputs are null, the output is
. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Preserve the entire schema block byte-for-byte. Change only sections/newsletter-goal-block.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
